verbatim_excerpt:
R1 R2 R3 R4 R5

In the districts indicated, the height and setback regulations of a building or other structure shall be as set forth in Section 23-421 (Basic pitched-roof envelopes for certain districts) and 23-422 (Basic flat-roof envelopes for certain districts). Where applicable, standard setback provisions are set forth in Section 23-423.

Such heights may be increased on qualifying residential sites or on zoning lots containing qualifying senior housing, or for certain large sites, pursuant to Sections 23-424 or 23-425, respectively.

The height of all buildings or other structures shall be measured from the base plane.
notes: Overview / routing section for R1-R5 height and setback: pitched-roof envelopes are set forth in 23-421, flat-roof envelopes in 23-422, and standard setback provisions in 23-423 where applicable. Heights may be increased on qualifying residential sites / qualifying senior housing / certain large sites (23-424, 23-425) and additional provisions appear in 23-426 and 23-44 - all of these are CONDITIONAL provisions (geography / lot-eligibility / overlay dependent) that are A2 gaps here (D-045-R008), never applied as numeric values in M4-T014.
All R1-R5 heights are measured from the base plane; the base-plane determination is a separate professional input, not a value this snapshot supplies.
